svg.aria-label: Three ways PostgreSQL reads a table: an index scan fetches matching heap rows one by one in index order, a bitmap heap scan sorts the matching pages and reads each once in physical order, and a sequential scan reads every page; the choice depends on how many rows match

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three ways to read a table

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Which scan is cheapest depends mostly on how many rows the predicate matches (its selectivity).

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Walk the index, fetch each matching heap row. Chosen when few rows match.
